help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%, enhances the fear duration by {Boost.Attrib.Fear.Scale}% and reduces endurance cost by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}%.
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy, Fear Duration, and Reduces Endurance Cost
